leadText:
Mistralton Tower (Japanese: フキヨセタワー Tower) is an -exclusive landmark in the Unova region. It is located along . A festival is held in its honor as well as a contest. Those who win the contest will have a chance to ring the bell at the top of the tower and make their potential wishes come true.

In Climbing the Tower of Success, , Stephan, and Ricky race to the top of the tower holding -shaped candles to win the grand prize in the Wishing Bell Festival. The tower itself has an extremely long spiral staircase inside, and several Pokémon inside, such as Litwick and . It is unknown, however, whether these Pokémon are wild or belonging to a .

It is nearly identical to the Celestial Tower in design and location. However, it is not a cemetery for as it is in the games.
